page_note: Page contains tail of one chapter (cosmological similes for First Man, ship, Living Spirit + hortatory closure) and opening of chapter 27 on the Five Likenesses in the Archons of Darkness. The new chapter is core substrate teaching: a five-fold zoomorphic mapping of the archon's body parts onto the five worlds of darkness (lion-head=fire, eagle-wings=wind, demon-feet=smoke, etc.) — pure cosmos→cosmos correspondence. Editorial layer is concentrated in the dialogue frame (segs 17, 25) and hortatory closure (segs 18-20). Heavy lacunae throughout.
